next_order_id returns one past the highest existing order number, as 'o' + 6-digit zero-padded. Uses max, not count, so gaps don't collide. Ids not matching _ORDER_ID are ignored.
next_order_id pages the orders collection via list_page/next_cursor, not iter_records: iter_records reads only the first page (100), so it would miss later orders and return a colliding id.
Accepted limits: deleting the highest order lets its id be reused; no locking, so concurrent callers can get the same id and must handle a save collision.
